title: Waypoint in one minute
caption: Waypoint in one minute: a place to say one true thing, without your name. Mira shows the main things on the real screens.
linkedin_text: A one-minute tour of Waypoint on its real screens: a new name every day, one true sentence, the Wall, polls, voice posts, matching and Mira the AI guide, a mood log, the Break Room and sixteen languages.

scenes.vo: Hi, I'm Mira. This is Waypoint in one minute: a place to say one true thing, without your name.
scenes.sub: Hi, I'm Mira. This is Waypoint in one minute: a place to say one true thing, without your name.

scenes.vo: Every day you get a new name, made just for today.
scenes.sub: Every day you get a new name, made just for today.

scenes.vo: Type one true sentence. That is all it asks.
scenes.sub: Type one true sentence. That is all it asks.

scenes.vo: Read what others wrote tonight, on the Wall.
scenes.sub: Read what others wrote tonight, on the Wall.

scenes.vo: Ask the Path: one question, two to four options.
scenes.sub: Ask the Path: one question, two to four options.

scenes.vo: Or tap Voice and talk. Others hear a character's voice.
scenes.sub: Or tap Voice and talk. Others hear a character's voice.

scenes.vo: Wait for a match, or talk to Mira, an AI guide.
scenes.sub: Wait for a match, or talk to Mira, an AI guide.

scenes.vo: Log your mood in a tap. No typing.
scenes.sub: Log your mood in a tap. No typing.

scenes.vo: Ninety seconds in the Break Room, once a day.
scenes.sub: Ninety seconds in the Break Room, once a day.

scenes.vo: Waypoint. Say it once. Free on Google Play, in many Indian and international languages.
